text:
maya: quick check — planning to flip runtime.spec_decoding_v2 for a 5% cohort in eu-west-1 tomorrow morning. want to validate scope & guardrails before i schedule the rollout.

sam: sounds good. what metrics are we watching in the first 30m?

maya: latency p50/p95, token error rate (new decoding OOMs), and any increase in invalid JSON outputs for structured responses. also watch cpu/gpu utilization and rpc retry spikes.

dmitri: +1 on metrics. add model-fallback rate (how often we hit fallback_kernel=v1) and kv-cache hit rate — spec decode changes might affect cache behavior.

piyush: do we have a safe kill switch? if we see >2% token error or p95 latency regresses >150ms we should auto-roll-back.

maya: yes — plan is: 1) launch 5% cohort; 2) 10m warmup; 3) check alerts; 4) auto rollback on the two guardrails below. created a small config snippet:

maya: ```json
{"flag":"runtime.spec_decoding_v2","audience":"eu-west-1:0.05","auto_rollback":true,"rollback_conditions":{"token_error_pct":2.0,"p95_latency_ms":150},"fallback":"fallback_kernel=v1","monitoring_channels":["#eng-runtime","#oncall"]}
```

nora: small request — include a canary bucket that excludes VIP customers (orgs with tag=enterprise). we don't want any hits there.

maya: good call. will add exclusion: audience -> eu-west-1:0.05 excluding tag:enterprise.

ops-bot: scheduled rollout for runtime.spec_decoding_v2 to eu-west-1 2026-05-03T09:00:00Z (5% traffic). Auto-rollback enabled.

sam: @dmitri can you give a quick thumbs-up on the runtime kernel guardrail instrumentation? i pushed a tiny change to the monitoring dashboard — PR 4021.

dmitri: saw PR 4021, left one comment about the alert threshold math. otherwise lgtm.

ci-bot: ci status: all checks passing for feature/spec-decode-canary (build #782). canary image: registry.redwood/infra/spec-decode:v2-20260503

piyush: i'll be on call during the rollout window. if anything noisy shows up tag me and i'll flip the flag.

maya: thanks everyone. action items: maya update flag audience to exclude enterprise + push final config, sam confirm dashboard alert knobs, dmitri merge PR, piyo on-call. i'll wait for thumbs before scheduling. :thumbsup:

nora: one more nit — run a small local perf run with kv disabled to reproduce potential cache miss regressions before rollout. 5–10k requests should surface oddness.

maya: doing that now, will paste results in thread shortly.

sam: pinged @legal about the feature set that might affect PII handling; they said no concerns but asked to record the rollout for audit.

maya: pasted quick perf run: "spec-decode v2 (kv on): p95=210ms, token_err=0.3% ; (kv off): p95=265ms, token_err=0.9%" — kv differences notable, so we keep kv enabled for canary.

dmitri: thanks — that aligns with expectations. final question: are we targeting streaming endpoints or batch gen?

maya: streaming first (chat API), batch endpoints will follow after a 24h observation window.

nora: OK ready on exclusions and monitoring.

maya: Scheduling for 2026-05-03T09:00Z. logging rollout id: rlt-20260503-specv2. will update ops runbook with rollback steps.

sam: cool. please paste the final flag payload when scheduled.

maya: will do. :rocket:

ops-bot: rollout rlt-20260503-specv2 created, cohort 5%, exclusion: tag=enterprise. notifications -> #eng-runtime, #oncall.

ci-bot: reminder: artifact retention for this rollout set to 30d.

piyush: ack and standby.

maya: thanks all — closing the loop here, will follow up with post-rollout summary.
